what: A chat answer (chat runs only, no task events) that asks the person to decide or makes a proposal (German and English, questions and statements; code blocks, quotes and lines about cards already posted do not count) but has no ```approval block goes back to the agent once in the same session (the complete answer again with the block, no tools); still without a block it is posted with a visible note that nothing happens without an explicit yes; KALMIDO_APPROVAL_CHECK=0 switches it off; 2.615.0 (#3658 / #2390, #3757 / #3753): an approval named in passing counts ("braucht deine Freigabe", "needs your approval", "sobald du freigibst", "once you approve"), "deine Freigabe" / "your approval" only as a question; advice against ("empfehle ich nicht", "I would not recommend") and quoted words or titles („…“, "…", “…”, «…») never
